verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded payments platform, and a platform of this kind could plausibly offer automation or rules versioning, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party automation objects with versioning, review, or rollback. The Zapier no-code workflow guidance describes a third-party tool built on Rainforest webhooks, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
